1	(* Layer 1: drop_perm / lift_perm — permutation compression and expansion. *)
2	(* Given σ : {perm 'I_n.+1}, [drop_perm σ] is the permutation of 'I_n       *)
3	(* obtained by deleting the position [ord_max] (mapping to [σ ord_max]) and  *)
4	(* collapsing around that value.  The inverse operation [lift_perm k τ]     *)
5	(* inserts a new maximum position sent to [k].                                *)
6	
7	From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect fingroup perm.
8	From mathcomp_eulerian Require Import ordinal_reindex.
9	
10	Set Implicit Arguments.
11	Unset Strict Implicit.
12	Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
13	
14	(* ========================================================================= *)
15	(* drop_perm                                                                *)
16	(* ========================================================================= *)
17	
18	Section DropPerm.
19	Variables (n : nat) (s : {perm 'I_n.+1}).
20	
21	Fact drop_fun_ne (i : 'I_n) : s ord_max != s (lift ord_max i).
22	Proof.
23	apply/eqP => /perm_inj /eqP.
24	by rewrite (negbTE (neq_lift ord_max i)).
25	Qed.
26	
27	Definition drop_fun (i : 'I_n) : 'I_n := sval (unlift_some (drop_fun_ne i)).
28	
29	Lemma drop_funE i : s (lift ord_max i) = lift (s ord_max) (drop_fun i).
30	Proof. by rewrite /drop_fun; case: (unlift_some _) => /= j -> _. Qed.
31	
32	Lemma drop_fun_inj : injective drop_fun.
33	Proof.
34	move=> i1 i2 /(congr1 (lift (s ord_max))).
35	by rewrite -!drop_funE => /perm_inj /lift_inj.
36	Qed.
37	
38	Definition drop_perm : {perm 'I_n} := perm drop_fun_inj.
39	
40	Lemma drop_permE i : drop_perm i = drop_fun i.
41	Proof. by rewrite permE. Qed.
42	
43	Lemma lift_drop_permE i :
44	  lift (s ord_max) (drop_perm i) = s (lift ord_max i).
45	Proof. by rewrite drop_permE -drop_funE. Qed.
46	
47	End DropPerm.
48	
49	(* ========================================================================= *)
50	(* lift_perm                                                                 *)
51	(* ========================================================================= *)
52	
53	Section LiftPerm.
54	Variables (n : nat) (k : 'I_n.+1) (t : {perm 'I_n}).
55	
56	Definition lift_fun (i : 'I_n.+1) : 'I_n.+1 :=
57	  match unlift ord_max i with
58	  | Some j => lift k (t j)
59	  | None => k
60	  end.
61	
62	Lemma lift_fun_ord_max : lift_fun ord_max = k.
63	Proof. by rewrite /lift_fun unlift_none. Qed.
64	
65	Lemma lift_fun_lift i : lift_fun (lift ord_max i) = lift k (t i).
66	Proof. by rewrite /lift_fun liftK. Qed.
67	
68	Lemma lift_fun_inj : injective lift_fun.
69	Proof.
70	move=> i1 i2; rewrite /lift_fun.
71	case: unliftP => [j1 ->|->]; case: unliftP => [j2 ->|->].
72	- by move/lift_inj/perm_inj ->.
73	- by move/eqP; rewrite eq_sym (negbTE (neq_lift _ _)).
74	- by move/eqP; rewrite (negbTE (neq_lift _ _)).
75	- by [].
76	Qed.
77	
78	Definition lift_perm : {perm 'I_n.+1} := perm lift_fun_inj.
79	
80	Lemma lift_permE i : lift_perm i = lift_fun i.
81	Proof. by rewrite permE. Qed.
82	
83	Lemma lift_perm_ord_max : lift_perm ord_max = k.
84	Proof. by rewrite lift_permE lift_fun_ord_max. Qed.
85	
86	Lemma lift_perm_lift i : lift_perm (lift ord_max i) = lift k (t i).
87	Proof. by rewrite lift_permE lift_fun_lift. Qed.
88	
89	Lemma lift_perm_ne_k i : i != ord_max -> lift_perm i != k.
90	Proof.
91	case: (unliftP ord_max i) => [j ->|->]; last by rewrite eqxx.
92	by move=> _; rewrite lift_perm_lift eq_sym neq_lift.
93	Qed.
94	
95	End LiftPerm.
96	
97	(* ========================================================================= *)
98	(* Cancellation lemmas                                                       *)
99	(* ========================================================================= *)
100	
101	Section Cancellation.
102	Variable n : nat.
103	
104	Lemma drop_perm_lift_perm (k : 'I_n.+1) (t : {perm 'I_n}) :
105	  drop_perm (lift_perm k t) = t.
106	Proof.
107	apply/permP => i; apply: (@lift_inj _ (lift_perm k t ord_max)).
108	by rewrite lift_drop_permE lift_perm_lift lift_perm_ord_max.
109	Qed.
110	
111	Lemma lift_perm_drop_perm (s : {perm 'I_n.+1}) :
112	  lift_perm (s ord_max) (drop_perm s) = s.
113	Proof.
114	apply/permP => i; rewrite lift_permE /lift_fun.
115	case: (unliftP ord_max i) => [j ->|->] //.
116	exact: lift_drop_permE.
117	Qed.
118	
119	Lemma lift_perm_ord_max_eq (k : 'I_n.+1) (t : {perm 'I_n}) :
120	  (lift_perm k t) ord_max = k.
121	Proof. exact: lift_perm_ord_max. Qed.
122	
123	End Cancellation.
